About Me

Crafting stories
at the edge of technology

Ten years of copywriting, social media and strategy, and I'm still finding new ways to make words and ideas work harder. I'm a creator at heart, equally at home in a video edit suite, a design brief, or a content strategy session.

Right now, my biggest obsession is AI and coding, using both to build smarter tools and more interesting work. I learn fast, think in systems, and have strong opinions about what makes a brand truly memorable. My superpower? Ideation. I come alive at the start of a project when the possibilities are wide open. I'll probably talk your ear off about it, consider yourself warned. Welcome to my world.
